senses.gloss: (cmp. שְׁרג, שְׁרִק) to slope, slip down, glide; to faint.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:7:2">Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>הוה מסתמיך … שַׁרְעִין וזקפון וכ׳</he> was leaning on two Goths (in going to bathe); they slipped (or broke down), and he helped them up &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:27">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 7:1:18">Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ר׳ ז׳ ש׳ בדיבוריה</he> R. Z. sank down while speaking (in the presence of a corpse); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:2:5">Koh. R. to VII, 2</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="P00227"><he>עֲנֵי</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:20">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הות … שַׁרְעָה וכ׳</he> his cloak slipped off his shoulders; <he>הא … שְׁרִיעָה</he> thy cloak has dropped.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 6:3:5">Y. Shebi. VI, 37ᵃ</cite> top <he>ש׳ מינה</he> he slipped away from it, i.e. he gave it up.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 2:1:5">Y. Peah II, beg. 16ᵈ</cite> <he>בעא … וש׳ מינה</he> wanted to argue …, and gave it up; Y. B. Bath. III, beg. 13ᵈ. Ib. VI, end, 15ᶜ <he>מעלל אנא ש׳</he> I may slip in going up; a. e.
